verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork's documented Scheduled tasks feature lets users create tasks that run automatically on a recurring basis or on demand, and it delivers finished outputs such as reports, briefings, and summaries back to the user. Recurring automated runs with returned results are clearly first-party documented. 'On demand' reads as a manual run-now trigger, so timed one-off scheduling is only implied. missing for 10: explicit one-off scheduling at a future time, detail on how results are surfaced or notified, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results

citations.quote: Scheduled tasks allow you to delegate work to Claude Cowork by creating tasks that run automatically on a recurring basis, or on demand.
you describe it once and Claude handles it on your schedule—delivering finished outputs like reports, briefings, and summaries every time.
With Cowork, you can describe an outcome, step away, and come back to finished work
